ownerStandard: Sway is two connected products: Live Rooms (current) and Self-Production (in progress). Whole-product launch remains HOLD until Live Rooms capabilities and Self-Production capabilities (including DistroKid-class external distribution as one outlet, not Sway’s identity) are independently production-verified under one account journey. See docs/SWAY_PRODUCT_STRUCTURE.md.

capabilities.label: Durable exact-original master storage and download
capabilities.holdReason: The private R2 adapter, live bucket, authenticated production upload/seal/share/download journey, exact-byte recovery, sealed-version UI, and unauthenticated HTTP denial are verified. The cross-account audit is implemented but still requires production database execution; separately controlled independent recovery is not configured or verified.

capabilities.label: Projects, private pairing, selected-file sharing, review, and approval
capabilities.holdReason: Pairing, selected immutable-version grants, exact authorized download, review, approval, grant/connection revocation, replay denial, and audit pass in a disposable durable integration. The complete two-account journey is not yet production verified.

capabilities.label: Release drafts, artwork, credits, territories, ISRC, and UPC
capabilities.holdReason: The release workspace now supports audited editing, artwork, full recording credits, territories, identifiers, optimistic revision checks, sealed rights declarations, independent review, and fail-closed readiness. Disposable PostgreSQL and production journey evidence are still required for this exact tree; no store delivery is enabled.

capabilities.label: Ordered multi-recording single, EP, and album assembly
capabilities.holdReason: Track add, per-track metadata and credits, reorder, remove, single/EP/album count validation, optimistic conflict denial, and rights-review locking are implemented. The exact disposable PostgreSQL journey and a production creator journey are not yet independently verified; provider-backed store delivery remains disabled.

capabilities.label: Contracted DSP delivery to selected stores
capabilities.holdReason: No contracted delivery provider or production delivery integration is active.

capabilities.label: Store status, corrections, failures, and takedowns
capabilities.holdReason: Lifecycle contracts exist without provider-backed execution evidence.

capabilities.label: Royalty statement import, reconciliation, and creator reporting
capabilities.holdReason: No separate royalty ledger or statement reconciliation runtime exists.

capabilities.label: Contract-versioned collaborator splits, KYC, tax, and payouts
capabilities.holdReason: Live-room payments cannot substitute for distribution royalties and collaborator payouts.

capabilities.label: Stable release promotion and pre-save pages
capabilities.holdReason: Stable public release pages and release cards on creator profiles are implemented. Provider-backed destination links, true pre-save actions, and destination update evidence remain missing.

capabilities.label: Safe catalog intake, parity lock, overlap verification, and cutover
capabilities.holdReason: Catalog transfer remains fail-closed without provider execution or production continuity evidence.

pillars.label: Live Rooms (original Sway / current operating product)

capabilities.label: One cohesive audience and creator account journey
capabilities.holdReason: Universal signup, login, session, logout, audience access, and atomic Pro Mode activation are implemented. The complete audience-to-creator journey is not production verified.

capabilities.label: Creator home and public profile
capabilities.holdReason: Creator home, website-replacement public profile, live-room entry, and verified public release cards are implemented. The complete production journey is not yet recorded in this gate.

capabilities.label: Performer-owned event listings and public discovery
capabilities.holdReason: Performer-owned event drafts, publishing, truthful cancellation, public event pages, profile listings, discovery, and safe external ticket handoff are implemented. A current production performer-to-customer event journey is not yet recorded.

capabilities.label: Native paid general-admission tickets
capabilities.holdReason: The isolated order, inventory, processor-event, ledger, rotating admission, refund-only unused-ticket, and post-check-in transfer paths are implemented behind a fail-closed gate. Production sales remain explicitly disabled. GO requires live Stripe and browser evidence, monitored buyer communication/support, production processor-fee/refund/dispute net-cash reconciliation, dispute and post-transfer reversal/reserve policy, tax/legal approval, and a clean-environment release gate.

capabilities.label: Live room, QR, requests, tips, boosts, and queue control
capabilities.holdReason: Production Stripe test-platform-balance runs proved request, tip, boost, void, refund, idempotency, closeout, repaired webhook replay, corrected refunded receipts, and a truthful zero-captured recap. Rendered browser tests proved the payment-dialog correction, and that exact code is deployed; no production-device viewport observation is claimed. Acceptance remains HOLD because the audience evidence used anonymous receipt-based sessions rather than a separately authenticated audience account, and the remaining patron UI outcome matrix needs a bounded current-build rerun.

capabilities.label: Role isolation, moderation, reporting, blocking, and fail-closed access
capabilities.holdReason: Production evidence covers anonymous protected-mutation denial, public projection containment, reporting, and a held block request. Disposable PostgreSQL proof covers durable active-block persistence and enforcement, but production does not yet prove separate authenticated audience-account isolation or an authorized enforced durable active block.

capabilities.label: Overlay, payment volume, end-room closeout, and recap
capabilities.holdReason: Production closeout and durable payment totals are recorded. A corrected-build rerun refunded both captured payments and truthfully showed zero captured volume and zero completed actions; test volume is explicit and non-shareable. The remaining HOLD belongs to the separate audience-account and moderation gates, not stale recap wording.
